notes:
61 shapes, indices 0-60, every one assigned exactly once (body 32, eyes 12, mouth 5, arms 4, legs 8).

NO double-drawn silhouette here: no shape repeats another shape's "d" as a stroke-only overlay. The only fill="none" shapes are the wing veins (1, 2, 4, 5, pink #F58FC5) and the eyebrows (54, 55, navy). The creature does have TWO silhouettes, both #5CC9F5 with a navy stroke: body 32 (x 144-372, y 330-540) and head 39 (x 118-400, y 102-378), drawn last of the two so the head sits on top. Both are BODY.

Body decoration, by painting order (all behind the two silhouettes except 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 40, 41, 42, 43): pink wings/fins 0 (screen-left, x 42-182) and 3 (screen-right, x 334-474), each with two #F58FC5 vein strokes (1, 2 left; 4, 5 right) - the two wings are near mirrors of each other. Six yellow crown spikes 6-11 across the top of the head, screen-left to screen-right, each with a pale cream highlight 12-17 in the same order. Two more yellow spikes 18, 19 on the body's screen-right flank (x 340-391, y 388-472); they are painted before the arms, so the right arm (30) covers most of them - they read as spikes poking out from behind it, but they are body spikes, not arm parts.

Shape 33 (#47BFF0 ellipse, cx 256 cy 336, rx 114) is a shading patch across the top of the body, half hidden under the head - body shading, not a belly. 36 is the pale belly, 37 its darker underside shading, 38 a white shine ellipse on the belly, 34/35 two light-blue spots on the body, 40 a light-blue highlight on the head's screen-left cheek, 41 the dark-blue shading on the head's screen-right side, 42/43 the blush cheeks.

ARMS are posed DIFFERENTLY, not mirrored: the screen-left arm 28 sweeps down and out to the lower left and ends in the blobby claw/hand 29 (x 56-138, y 434-512); the screen-right arm 30 reaches out almost horizontally and ends in hand 31 (x 414-486, y 356-434), about 90px higher and a different shape. Each arm must be kept as its own drawing.

LEGS are the same drawing repeated, not a true mirror: foot 21 is foot 20 translated by about +132 in x and -2 in y (only the right edge differs by 2px), and each foot is itself roughly left-right symmetric with three toes. Toe highlights: 22/23/24 (cx 172/196/220) on the screen-left foot, 25/26/27 (cx 302/326/350) on the screen-right foot. Marked legsSymmetric true because the pose is identical; note it is a translated copy rather than a mirrored one.

COLOURS that span two parts: #43BAEF is used by both the arms (28-31) and the legs (20, 21); #A2E4FC is used by the legs' toe highlights (22-27) and by body decoration (34, 35, 40); #FFFFFF is used by the belly shine (38, body), the eyeballs and catchlights (44, 45, 50-53, eyes) and the teeth (58-60, mouth); the navy #0B1B3B is the outline of every part and is ALSO the fill of the pupils (48, 49) and the stroke of the eyebrows (54, 55) - one value, so one entry with role "ink"; a repaint must keep it literal everywhere.

This drawing has THREE darker blues, not one or two: #43BAEF (limbs), #47BFF0 (upper-body shading) and #3CB2E8 (head shading), all darker versions of the main #5CC9F5, so all three carry role "dark" and should be derived from the main colour. It also has THREE pale versions: #A2E4FC (spots, highlights, toes), #E6F7FF (belly) and #C6E9FB (belly shading), all role "light". The yellow accent comes in two tones as well: #FFD23F (spikes) and #FFE9A6 (their cream highlight); the pink wing accent likewise: #FFB3D9 (wing) and #F58FC5 (its veins) - inside each pair the second value is the shaded/highlight version of the first and should be recoloured together with it. Truly fixed values that must never change: #0B1B3B ink, #FFFFFF, #FF9EC7 cheeks, #FFB43C iris, #D8496F mouth cavity, #FF9BB8 tongue.

One process note: the flattened file flat/6-SpikeaBoo.json did not exist (only 1-Bricky, 2-Fuzzbop, 3-Wobble were there), so I re-ran the pipeline's own flatten.cjs on the SVG into a scratchpad temp file to get authoritative indices. No project or pipeline file was edited. The SVG has no groups and no transforms, so index = shape order = SVG line number minus 2.
